utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem. I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know who’s bringing the tools and when the work starts so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Who’s bringing the tools, and what time do you want to start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help if someone brings the tools, and I’d rather start after lunch so I can work it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might've missed the latest part, but what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly I need a hand with the heavy stuff, if you can manage it. I keep forgetting the exact list, but I know it helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can handle the heavy stuff. Just point me at the list when you remember it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. What part do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I need someone to cover the wiring and another person to pick up the parts. Could you take the parts run?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can take the parts run. Just tell me where to pick them up and what I should grab.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. What’s left to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’ve still got a few loose ends: sorting the tools, carrying the lumber, and getting the last shelf mounted. I’m glad you’re here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the tools and lumber, then help mount that shelf.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: let’s set a clear time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, then let’s make it official: Saturday at 10 works for me, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much of the repair drive still needs to be finished?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: There’s still a bit left, but we’re close. I can help check what’s remaining if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, let's check what's left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help get the word out if you want me to. What still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and pull a couple more hands in. What’s left on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, I’ll check in with the crew and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara. I’ll keep the neighbors posted and check back once you hear from the crew.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’ll make sure the crew stays on it, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies, but I need to know what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just need the basics right now: nails, wood glue, and a couple more replacement boards.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of those and let you know if we’re short on anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam again, and folks are trying to get everything fixed before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard that too. Looks like everyone’s trying to get ahead of it before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and I’m hearing a few more volunteers showed up this morning, so they might actually finish ahead of schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we know what still needs fixing on the drive? I want to check the details before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still checking the list, but I know the main thing is the broken fence near the back and a few loose boards by the walkway.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Let me know when you have the full list so I can help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the parts and a few tools. I’m picking up the rest this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll grab the tools then. Tell me if you need anything else from the store.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I’ll tell a few more neighbors and make sure they know where to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word and point neighbors to the signup table.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I might've missed the latest update, but I can help if you catch me up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can catch you up later, but for now I just need a hand with the basics.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, just point me at the basics and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Rey. I’ve got a few tools here already, so if you can spare some time, we can knock it out together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. Let’s get started and I’ll help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready, and I can add your name to the repair drive list if you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put you down and bring the list by later so we can match people to the right repairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m just worried we’ll get stuck if the parts don’t arrive on time. Can we make sure there’s a backup plan?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll line up a backup batch and a couple of volunteers so we’re covered if anything slips.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but can you also confirm who’s bringing the spare tools?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, but I want to confirm the details first before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but you still haven’t confirmed the details yet, have you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive, Dane. Tell me what’s first and what time you’re aiming for.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’d start with sorting the biggest repair first and aim to be there by 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll be there by 6:30, and we can start with the biggest repair first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I’m a little out of the loop. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it’s underway. Folks are dropping off tools and spare parts at the community center, so if you’ve got anything to contribute, that’s the spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know. I might swing by the community center later and see if I’ve got anything useful to drop off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was going to ask Mara for the list of houses again, because I misplaced it somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, I can swing by and grab it if you’ve got a spare minute. Then we can make sure I don’t lose it again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the schedule, but I need to know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m checking that now. I’ll get you the date and time so you can slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, just send me the date and time when you have it.
